recovery.title: Password recovery
recovery.description: Help this user choose a new password. Creating a new link replaces any previous unused link. Disabled accounts stay disabled.
recovery.unavailableReason: Saved SMTP settings must be configured and successfully tested. You can still create and copy a reset link.
recovery.readinessFailed: Email readiness could not be checked. You can still create and copy a reset link.
recovery.expiry: This link can be used once and expires in {{count}} minutes.
recovery.bearerAdvice: Anyone with this link can reset this user’s password until it expires. Share it only with the intended user.
recovery.copyFallback: Link selected. Use your device’s Copy command to copy it manually.
recovery.sent: Password reset email sent. The link expires in 60 minutes.
recovery.sendFailed: The email could not be sent. Check email configuration and try again; each attempt creates a new link.
recovery.createFailed: The reset link could not be created. Check that the trusted application URL is configured and try again.
recovery.policy: Use at least {{count}} characters. Do not include your email address or the name before @.
recovery.policyError: Use at least {{count}} characters and avoid your account email address or the name before @.
recovery.resetFailed: Your password could not be changed. Please try again.
recovery.success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password. If your account is disabled, contact your administrator.
recovery.reset_used: This reset link has already been used or replaced
recovery.requestAnother: Ask your administrator for a new password reset link.
recovery.rolesLoadFailed: Roles could not be loaded. Reload this page to choose roles before creating the user.
recovery.detailDescription: Manage profile details, account access, roles, and password recovery.
recovery.deleteDescription: Permanently remove this user. Disable the account instead if you only need to suspend access.
recovery.resetUnavailable: Reset link could not be checked
recovery.scrollTable: Scroll horizontally to see all account details.
